PETREX GMBH is a distinguished chemical company headquartered at Wachtendonker Straße 11 in Kempen, Germany (D-47906), strategically positioned in the heart of North Rhine-Westphalia's industrial region. As a specialized player in the chemical industry, PETREX GMBH has established itself as a reliable partner for businesses seeking high-quality chemical solutions and products.

Located in Kempen, a town with excellent connectivity to major European markets, PETREX GMBH benefits from Germany's renowned chemical industry infrastructure and expertise. The company operates from its facilities in this well-connected industrial area, which provides optimal access to both suppliers and customers throughout Europe and beyond. Germany's position as one of the world's leading chemical producers provides PETREX GMBH with access to cutting-edge technology, skilled workforce, and established supply chains.

The company's location in the Lower Rhine region places it within one of Europe's most important chemical industry clusters, facilitating collaboration and innovation within the sector. PETREX GMBH leverages this advantageous position to serve diverse market segments with chemical products and services that meet stringent quality standards. Their commitment to excellence and customer satisfaction has made them a trusted name in the chemical industry, contributing to the strong reputation of German chemical manufacturing on the global stage.
